scientific_integrity: The exact variance follows from analytic Gaussian moments. Finite exact-rational and simulation checks corroborate, but do not replace, the infinite-family proof. Historical publication priority cannot be established exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite-sample inequality applies to independent standard Gaussian nodes, a single linear control, a cubic-plus-linear integrand, and exact regression arithmetic; it is not a general superiority guarantee against other integration algorithms.
title: Four samples reverse the oracle comparison for Gaussian cubic regression control variates
